name: field-type
body: Field type: text (inline Markdown, body inline rules; links validated like body links) | number (plain YAML number; strings are type errors) | date (`YYYY-MM-DD`) | boolean | enum | image | link | list(of one item type) | record (an inline nested record with its own `fields:`, record-item-type) | <section-template>. Every type may be `nullable` (nullable-fields).
